summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend smoke testing of Lenden Prohori Phase 1. Wrote pytest suite covering auth (seeded accounts + register + logout + role gating), full deal lifecycle (accept-terms -> fund -> deliver -> inspect PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN -> ACCEPTED_RELEASE, confirming cosmetic completion % does NOT gate release), mutual-resolution split (two-party approval + ledger conservation), disputes queue + reviewer resolution + unresolved path (funds stay held), research subjects + search + resolution_of linkage + compare without trust score, community reports draft->submit->moderate->publish->respond, service-modes, and rule-based assistant endpoints. 33/33 pytest cases pass. Frontend Playwright smoke verified landing, buyer login, home paths, bilingual toggle switches text, Research shows seeded subjects, compare renders with disclaimer and no trust-score key, Deal room LP-D-DEMO0001 renders completion map/ledger/release button, moderation shows permission-denied-style empty state for non-reviewer and loads correctly for reviewer.
critical_code_review_comments: deals.py review endpoint rule 'reviewer cannot review a dispute they opened' is enforced only by user_id equality. Since reviewers are rarely parties, in practice this is a defensive check — fine for Phase 1.
research.py /subjects does a per-subject per-kind count_documents (N x 4 queries). Minor perf concern at scale; acceptable for Phase 1 seeded data.
CORS allow_origins uses explicit FRONTEND_URL + localhost which is correct for credentialed cookies (not '*'). Cookie flags secure+samesite=none+httponly set correctly.
auth.py uses bcrypt with $2b$ hashes via bcrypt.hashpw (verified by successful logins). seed_users is idempotent and re-syncs password_hash each boot.
No mongo _id leakage observed in any inspected endpoint response (all use projection {_id:0} or _pub()/_public() strippers).
test_credentials: Seeded accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md all work: admin@/Admin@12345, reviewer@/Review@12345, buyer@/Buyer@12345, seller@/Seller@12345 (all @lendenprohori.com).
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed deals and one TEST_report for lifecycle/split/dispute/moderation flows via API. Not cleaned up (acceptable; prefixed for identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Playwright smoke covered Landing, Login, Home, Research+Compare, DealRoom (demo LP-D-DEMO0001), Moderation permission + reviewer view. If deeper UI testing is required later, next flows to exercise: Report editor draft creation + approve-publication-checkbox + submit; buyer clicking inspect-<id>-PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN then release-btn on a fresh (non-demo) deal; dispute-submit modal; moderation publish + review-resolve as reviewer. All data-testids are present and kebab-case.
